messages:
leah: EmberCorp wants a 2-week POC. Requirements: SAML SSO across tenant subdomains, SCIM initial import (~120k users) + delta, Okta group->role mapping, and short-lived session tokens for backend services. Can we confirm ops steps and any contract constraints? cc @carlos @sam

carlos: Quick take: SAML SP supported. We recommend SAML -> ACS -> mint JWT (15m) for downstream services. We don't proxy IdP cookies.

sam: Pricing note: SCIM calls not billed per-user on hosted plan. Huge sustained imports may need Dedicated or quota bump in contract.

carlos: SCIM: use 1k chunk batches, backoff on 429s. We expose If-Modified-Since for delta sync.

security-qa-bot: Security ticket #1203 created. Requested: IdP metadata, SCIM TLS ciphers, audit export requirements. Link: https://redwood/secq/1203

leah: Ops checklist for kickoff?

carlos: Send IdP metadata + test Okta export (50 users). We'll run staging import, show backoff behavior, demo token-exchange endpoint.

infra-bot: Job queued: scim-import-staging-120k (job id jb-2121). Monitor for 429 events.

sam: I'll add note to quote about audit retention add-on (90d default).

leah: Thanks team — scheduling kickoff Thu 11am PT. Invite incoming.
